result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: overlapping/conflicting text below the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing where delivery time and delivery fee labels render on top of each other, making both unreadable.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time text ('25–30 min delivery') and the delivery fee text ('€0 delivery') overlap directly on top of each other, rendering both lines illegible.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the delivery time and delivery fee render as separate lines or properly spaced inline elements (e.g., correct the missing/incorrect bullet separator or overlapping text container).
